prompt: Which title and introduction would fit both the station’s instructions and the contributor’s choice about identification?
promptZh: 哪個標題與介紹方式同時符合電台指示和投稿者對具名的選擇？

options.text: “The Shed on Ferry Row,” introduced under the contributor’s name.
options.zh: 〈渡口街的電車庫〉，以投稿者姓名介紹。
options.whyZh: 渡口街是舊名，標題應用現名；投稿者也想讓姓名欄留白。

options.text: “The Shed on Ferry Row,” introduced as a story from “a neighbor.”
options.zh: 〈渡口街的電車庫〉，介紹為「一位鄰居」的故事。
options.whyZh: 不具名的介紹正確；標題仍須用現行街名。

options.text: “The Shed on Canal Street,” introduced as a story from “a neighbor.”
options.zh: 〈運河街的電車庫〉，介紹為「一位鄰居」的故事。
options.whyZh: 標題使用現行街名運河街；姓名欄留白時依電台規則介紹為「一位鄰居」。

options.text: “The Shed on Canal Street,” introduced under the contributor’s name.
options.zh: 〈運河街的電車庫〉，以投稿者姓名介紹。
options.whyZh: 街名正確；但投稿者不想在表單留下姓名，電台不會以姓名介紹。

explanationZh: 標題使用現行街名運河街；姓名欄留白時依電台規則介紹為「一位鄰居」。
evidence: Give the place’s current street name in the title, even if you use its old name in the story. / If you leave your name off the form, the host will introduce you as “a neighbor.” / The draft title uses the former street name, Ferry Row. It’s Canal Street now. I’d rather leave my name off the form.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Give the place’s current street name in the title, even if you use its old name in the story.
If you leave your name off the form, the host will introduce you as “a neighbor.”
The draft title uses the former street name, Ferry Row. It’s Canal Street now. I’d rather leave my name off the form.

vocabulary.note: leave X off a form 表示不將該項填進表單。
